discovery.evidence: Live official State of Mexico congress legislation portal (catalog page with per-document download links, sections Constitucion/Ley/Codigo/Reglamento) fetched 2026-11-14; catalog sha256 b4ed2078cec812c0e664d3a9abbb9776f302a55f02405a037c44293609833c0b. 261 unique documents enumerated (constitucion 1, codigos 8, leyes 245, reglamentos 7): 220 .doc OLE, 35 .docx, 6 .pdf; no normalized-title duplicates. Host located via public web search after institutional site (congresoedomex.gob.mx, Next.js) showed no law links; guessed subdomains NOT probed beyond one DNS check each. Full HEAD sweep 2026-11-14: 261x HTTP 200, max 6,908,656 bytes, 0 over 10MB. Batch 18/27: mex-ley-170, mex-ley-171, mex-ley-172, mex-ley-173, mex-ley-174, mex-ley-175, mex-ley-176, mex-ley-177, mex-ley-178, mex-ley-179.

rightsReview.basis: Bounded acquisition of official state legislative texts under the same documented basis as the closed programs: LFDA art. 14 frac. VIII (documented basis, not a legal conclusion). Verified 2026-11-14 before acquisition: robots.txt 200 allow-all (User-agent: * with empty Disallow; no AI-agent rules, no content-signals); aviso de privacidad page present, no terms-of-use or reuse/IP prohibition located (absence of terms is NOT treated as express authorization by the owner); official state congress portal publishing direct document downloads; no blocks with default user agent. Scope limited to official normative texts listed on the catalog; quarantine only; no publication, no product activation. Stop the source if any restriction or challenge appears.
